description: Helper functions for loading and managing Superset example datasets, including URL normalization, data loading from Parquet files, and slice management.

methods.name: get_table_connector_registry
methods.description: Returns the SqlaTable registry for mocking in tests.

methods.name: get_examples_folder
methods.description: Returns the local path to the examples folder.

methods.name: update_slice_ids
methods.description: Updates slice IDs in a position JSON and returns the slices.

methods.name: merge_slice
methods.description: Upserts a Slice object into the database.

methods.name: get_slice_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for a chart definition, merging defaults with extra kwargs.

methods.name: normalize_example_data_url
methods.description: Converts example data URLs to normalized file:// URLs, handling the examples:// protocol.

methods.name: read_example_data
methods.description: Loads data from local Parquet files based on example name or URL.
